title: Bodycam: Florida Couple Caught ‘Having Fun’ on Beach to Fulfill Woman’s ‘Dreams,’ Police Say
description:
A Florida woman said it was "always a dream of hers" to engage in intercourse on a beach. However, what Sara Fazekas did not consider is that not only is this highly illegal, but also outright gross and disrespectful to other people in the area. Fazekas and Robert Clarke were allegedly caught making her dreams come true on November 10, 2023. Bodycam footage shows Pinellas County deputies confronting the couple after numerous bystanders reported the unsightly scene. Find out what happened next on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
